notes.title: "Revival & Exploration" Official Launch! Build a cozy city together!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ba696cc8c8445a66b914d28b4c7b05e6926b6566.png[/img]
 "Revival & Exploration" officially launched on Steam on May 22, and is free to play. We welcome everyone to download and experience it!

[h1] 1. Build a beautiful city as you wish. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/2c57e54e74f20c18b4cae2268a02c6d372582d65.png[/img]
In a prosperous and peaceful corner of the Yudian continent, a small town sits by the cliff, where residents work at sunrise and return at sunset, living a happy and tranquil life. But the wars ignited by the demons shattered the town’s peace, and the cliffside town was destroyed overnight, leaving only ruins. As the lord, you must shoulder the responsibility to rebuild the city with the residents, develop trade, and explore various terrains such as deserts, swamps, and ice fields. Befriend local tribes, meet new friends, and ultimately establish a town more glorious than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/8d2f01c0a221afc5ea747abb56947f7e3d1f80ea.png[/img]
 In the world of Revival & Exploration, you’ll gather materials through outdoor exploration, construct the town, craft equipment to sell to visitors, and earn funds to purchase more land and buildings, boosting your town’s prosperity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/48cd5c7a6e08c424270f6a43f5ff98ec9fe8431b.png[/img]
The game features soft, bright colors and a cute, chibi art style, accompanied by cheerful and pleasant background music. All town residents work at sunrise and rest at sunset, and will proactively help with transporting materials or repairing houses. You can leisurely plan your city layout or dispatch people to explore at any time, returning together with loads of materials. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/df760c2e42c73dd08c88961662b707ff32fb9b44.png[/img]
There are over a dozen unique professions in the game, and different buildings have distinct functions: the tailor shop can craft lightweight gear, the eatery continuously sells specialty snacks, and the magic cannon can automatically attack incoming enemies. Road planning is also a skill—connecting buildings yields full benefits, and pedestrians move much faster on roads. To get rich, build roads first!

[h1] 2. Merchants gather, trade connects the world. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/5fdc217cf5aa7eddfe061602fc8380a28f6b631a.png[/img]
As your city grows, more and more merchants and visitors will come to this new city on the plains. You can bargain for big profits, make friends and sell at low prices, or even persuade guests to swap for their preferred items. Respond actively to the needs of visitors and merchants, and turn your city into a prosperous trade center!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/a1525d85bed382b8efe29ff28c7ed84537e1a750.png[/img]

In Yudian, you’ll encounter all kinds of adventures beyond managing your own land. You might meet the three wandering tanuki brothers, a reclusive alchemy master, or a mysterious little beggar... 

[h1]3. Break through the fog, seek treasures, and enjoy adventure. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/6d7a73f6433e020681557c4cd9a3e6a00d43878b.png[/img]
The Yudian continent offers a vast space for lords to freely explore, including volcanoes, ice fields, ruins, and other unique terrains. Most areas on the map are shrouded in thick fog, hiding many monsters, treasures, and secret realms. Various ancient ruins and treasures await you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/f249ce229e55c05843b1eff77a81cde337907a32.png[/img]
Many tribes are scattered across Yudian, living in isolation. You can meet all kinds of people, help them solve problems, build relationships, and exchange resources! Try to unite the tribes and work together to build the town and resist demon invasions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ad1b9119c02b0e5f52611b59e574df2705cfc3f9.png[/img]
The charm of Revival & Exploration is not just in construction and gathering, but in the clever integration of character development and open-world exploration. The town you carefully manage will support your adventures, while the treasures you find will help your city thrive even more. Building and exploring go hand in hand, just as the game’s name suggests. 

[h1]4. Official launch—explore Yudian freely. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/934e6dcefb565e430e51fbeb80b763ae9a4aef69.png[/img]
A paradise always exists, and beautiful landscapes fill your dreams. If you’re interested in city management and want to build your own utopia, or if you prefer character development and want to see your rare residents embark on adventures, welcome to the world of Revival & Exploration! On May 22, let’s meet in Yudian and become the lord of a new continent!

notes.title: Revival and Exploration Goes Live on May 22!
notes.content:
Revival and Exploration goes live on Steam on May 21(PT), 2025. Build the Cozy City with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/61392bb471399c7044626fb26f5783dc35ada382.jpg[/img] 

The land of Yudian is bursting with spiritual energy. It's a resource-rich continent with stunning scenery and crystal-clear waters—a true paradise. But now, the demon tribe has eyes on this fertile land and has begun their invasion. To protect this haven, you'll rebuild from scratch after your city is attacked, carefully plan your town's growth, expand into forests, snowy fields, volcanoes, and more, meet new friends, and ultimately create a city even more glorious than before!

[h3]Development & Prosperity[/h3]

In Revival and Exploration, you'll head out on adventures to gather materials, build up your town, craft weapons to sell to visitors and merchants for funds, and buy more land and buildings to boost your town's prosperity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b32ffd6747557aa3985b5dcdd90856305fd54de7.png[/img]

No complicated quests or micromanaging here. Residents go about their day—working at sunrise, resting at sunset—and will jump in to help move materials or fix up buildings when needed. You can chill out and design your city layout, watching your home transform from ruins to a thriving hub. Or, send your residents out exploring and bring back loads of loot together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/04bac7bcf2fc5bfa50055577a96a255e9ad39b17.png[/img]

As your city grows, more merchants and visitors will get curious about this new town on the plains and come to check it out. Some will wander around sightseeing, others will hang out at the inn. You can haggle for big profits, make friends offer sweet deals, or even talk guests into swapping for their favorite items. A thriving city needs a steady flow of funds—so meet the needs of visitors and merchants, and turn your town into a bustling trade center!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/fa1b082a1c371555c6ffd841b54a03c17d24b317.png[/img]

[h3]World Exploration[/h3]

Resources around your town are limited. When your town gets big and hits a bottleneck, why not venture deeper into Yudian for treasure and adventure? The continent is huge, with volcanoes, icy plains, ruins, and more to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/9cd8d6601c29ef40750e38ac0ace1971204b67ca.png[/img]

Travel through deserts and swamps, and you'll discover your town isn't the only human settlement out there. Many ancient and mysterious tribes are scattered across Yudian, but due to demon attacks or old traditions, they've stayed isolated. Meet all kinds of people, help them out, build relationships, and trade resources. Try uniting the tribes, working together to build up your town and fend off the demon invasion—become the pillar of Yudian!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b0e2ff0401b3a9dd560eb57606690e51a942ab0a.png[/img]

Revival and Exploration is going to be released on May 22! Follow us and add Revival and Exploration to your wishlist, stay tuned for all the latest news!
